name: tenant_and_attendance
about: tenant_api has no destructive resets; vehicle_attendance scopes its resets by its own VAT vehicle-number prefix. Neither can collide with the other, and both are sub-2-second suites, so they share a leg rather than each paying the full bring-up cost alone.

name: mileage_boundary
about: mileage_recalc_test.dart was split into the 4 mileage_* files because it alone was ~88% of this job's test time. Each file gets its own isolated compose stack and DB, so its resetMileageData() (tenant-wide DELETE on fuel/mileage rows) can never collide with another leg.

name: mileage_edit
about: One of the 4 mileage_* legs; see mileage_boundary.

about: One of the 4 mileage_* legs; see mileage_boundary.

about: One of the 4 mileage_* legs; see mileage_boundary.
